name.en: Sauropod manus pes trackway form study

description.en: Trace-morphology concept informed by Gonzalez Riga2011 Titanopodus photos/map and original2009 indexed abstract. Manus/pes outline and wide-gauge morphology are source-supported; exact six-print sequence, miniature0.38m display, depth, colors and surface shape are illustrative, not a measured cast. No producer species, locomotor speed or unique behavior inferred. Cretaceous refers to source examples, not complete range.
